storage.value:
As a system user
I want to be able update product data to its current version or create a new version
So that I have possibility to correct my mistake and update product information without affecting existing contract 

Acceptance Criteria 

  • Check system user permissions to see edit icon on product listing/product detail page, if no such permission, edit icon will be disabled

    1. Editing product

      1. Allows to edit all products in system

    2. Clicking on an edit icon in product listing or in product detail page will allow product edit mode

    3. Editing operation is enabled only if product doesn’t have any connection in other object in system  

    4. By default system will load latest product version 

    5. Connection between product and groups (group of penalties, group of terms etc.) are timebased, so group will always load currently active version data

      1. In edit mode clicking on a group will open group preview page in a new browser window and than it will be possible to edit group from that page

    6. Individual object unlike groups does not have any versioning, so connection between Product and individual object is ID based (not version based)

      1. In edit mode clicking on an object will open object preview page in a new browser window and than it will be possible to edit object from that page 

    7. In the edit mode Individual Product checkbox and Customer identifier should be disabled

    8. Version’s dropdown in bottom right side will allow to display other product versions and to update them

    9. in the versioning dropdown - after the date and time to be the status of the product - Active/Inactive.

    10. All fields can be edited in Product so in editing mode all fields are enabled

    11. It is possible to edit latest product version or old product versions 

    12. It is possible to 'Update existing version' or to ‘Create new version’

    13. Clicking on a button 'Update existing version' will update existing product version

      1. e.g. product has Version 1 and version 2

      2. Product version 1 is edited as existing version

      3. Result: Version 1 is updated, version 2 is not changed 

    14. Clicking on a button ‘Create new version’ will create new version of product with updated data and previous version will not be changed

      1. All sub-objects will be copied in a new version

      2. All objects will be copied and then linked to new version of a product

      3. Groups will be directly linked to a new version of a product

    15. Audit Log record should be created on editing process

User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to select automatic update checkbox in product new version creation process for certain products versions

So that newly created product version will be added to selected contract

 

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Check system user permissions to select Automatic contract update checkbox in product while creation a new version

    1. If user doesn't have permission, then it is not possible to select the checkbox

  2. When user has permission and the system user tries to create new version of the product, a modal window should be displayed if newly created product version contains fixed parameters

  3. All products versions will be displayed in modal window doesn’t matter this product version was fixed or not

  4. User should be able to select more than one version of product and Save changes. Clicking on Save button will create New version of product and update all contracts which are linked to selected product versions.

    1. contract with statuses shouldn’t be affected: Cancelled, Terminated

    2. All other contracts should be updated

    3. All contract version should be updated - current, future

      1. Should create new version which starts today based on current version and update only newly created version and future versions

Fixed product should contain fields:

  1. To allow to allow to update contracts if new product version is fixed. So, all conditions should be covered: . if one of the condition fails shouldn’t display Modal window for updating contracts.

    • Status Product is Active and Available for sale is checked with additional conditions:

      • If Period from/to is defined and current day is in range

      • If period from is defined and current day is more then period from

      • If period to is defined and current day is less then period to

      • If period from/to is empty

    • Product is not individual or deleted

    • Contract type

      • Only one option is selected

    • Contract term

      • Product has only one payment term

        • To check additionally contract term type - should be Period, without term, other

        • If type is certain date - do not display such product

    • Invoice payment term

      • To check if group is added or term directly to product. In case of group should display directly without additional filtering. If term is directly added to product to have additional checks:

        • Only one invoice payment term is added to term

        • Value is added (no need to check value from /to)

          • In update process Value should be saved in contract

    • Payment guarantee

      • Only one checkbox should be selected

      • If 'Cash Deposit' checkbox is selected system should additionally check Cash deposit Amount and currency to be filled

      • If 'Bank Guarantee' checkbox is selected system should additionally check Bank guarantee amount and currency to be filled

      • If 'Cash deposit and bank guarantee' checkbox is selected system should additionally check Cash deposit amount, currency, bank guarantee amount, currency to be filled

    • Price component values

      • To check all price components added in contract:

        • Directly added

        • Added in group of price components current version (no need to check future versions here)

        • Added in advance payments (which is linked directly to product or group of advance payment's currently active version)

      • To check If price component Value is added (no need to check value from /to)

        • In update process Value should be saved in contract

      • Visualization of the names of the price component values :

        1. If X1 in price component “TEST Component 1” is named “TEST VALUE“ in the 3rd tab of Product contract: it should be shown as TEST VALUE (X1 from TEST Component 1)

    • Entering into force

      • To check if only one value is added

        • To check additionally if type is 'Exact day' or 'Manual' -  do not display such product

        • No need to display entering into force option in 3rd tab, but in saving should save the option in contract side

    • Start of the initial term of the contract

      • To check if only one value is added

        • To check additionally if type is 'Exact day' or 'Manual' -  do not display such product

        • No need to display entering into force option in 3rd tab, but in saving should save the option in contract side

    • Supply activation after contract resigning

      • To check if only one value is added

        • To check additionally if type is 'Exact day' -  do not display such product

        • If type is 'From first day of the month following the date of signing of the contract' to check additionally 'Wait for old contract term to expire (for resigning) has only one value selected

        • If type is manual directly display such product

        • No need to display entering into force option in 3rd tab, but in saving should save the option in contract side

    • Interim and advance payment

      • To check advance payments added directly in product or via groups currently active version

      • If 'at least one is selected' do not display such product

      • If Obligatory selected in all advance payments then to have additional check:

        • Value type

          • If Value type is '% from pervious invoice amount' or 'exact amount' then value to be filled

          • If Value type is 'price component' then to check in price component value to be filled

        • Date of issue

          • If 'Date of the month' or 'Working days after invoice date' is selected then value to be filled

          • If match the invoice date is selected or Periodical - in this case do not need additional check and display directly advance payment

        • Payment term

          • If 'Matches with the term of the standard invoice' is selected display

          • If payment term is added to check additionally that Value is added

            • In update process Value should be saved in contract

      • if product /service has directly added advance payment which has Days after invoice date selected then additionally should be checked Value to be defined and value from/to to be empty.

        • If interim and advance payment has different settings than this product shouldn’t be able to update.

    • Equal monthly installments

      • To check if equal monthly installments checkbox is selected or not

      • If not selected display directly the product

      • If selected to check additionally the values are filled or not

        • Number of installments value should be filled

          • In update process Value should be saved in contract

        • Amount value should be filled

          • In update process Value should be saved in contract

    • Segment

      • if customer is selected should check additionally customer’s segment to be matched to product’s segment

        • it is possible customer to have more than one segment selected; in this case if product contains at least one segment it means that product is available to customer and display such product

        • if in product All is selected there it means that product is available for all customers and no need to have additional checks

    • Sales channel

      • Should display only services available for Sales channels of the user. If user is not connected to any sales channel, he/she should be able to see all services (Login Portal integration is included in next bundles)

    • Additional 12 fields

      • Check if checkbox is selected and if selected its value should be added. If not - should skip automatic update process
